result.title: Put the World Back: Timestamps Matter in Time Series Reasoning
result.comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Foundation Models for Temporal Systems. 34 pages. Equal contribution: Tingrui Huang and Yuanyuan Deng
result.summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly applied to time series reasoning. However, current evaluations often give models events in chronological order and already matched to the time series. This makes it unclear whether models use timestamps to connect events with observations or simply take shortcuts. To expose this ambiguity, we reformulate time series reasoning from a world-to-series projection perspective, viewing timestamps as explicit indices that connect numerical observations and external events to shared world states. We identify three structures that timestamps can make explicit: temporal causal structure, time semantics, and event-series alignment. Building on this perspective, we develop a diagnostic protocol that distinguishes timestamp-grounded reasoning from correlational shortcuts, a distinction that accuracy-based benchmarks cannot make. Controlled interventions on 310 questions from two tasks show that high accuracy can persist when timestamps are replaced by relative offsets or removed, while breaking event-series alignment induces systematic failures. When context is pre-aligned, models barely need timestamps. When order is missing, they use dates to recall world knowledge. Without dates, they rely on correlational shortcuts and rarely notice incorrect timestamps. These findings show that high accuracy on pre-aligned, ordered inputs does not establish that a model uses timestamps to synchronize observations with the world. We release our code, model outputs, and trajectory labels at https://github.com/tingrui-huang/timestamps-matter.

AI.brief_summary: 论文把时间戳视为连接数值观测与外部事件的显式索引，提出区分「基于时间戳的推理」与相关性捷径的诊断协议，并在 310 道题上做替换、去除时间戳及破坏对齐的受控干预实验。
AI.relevance_reason: 其受控干预与轨迹标注的诊断设计可供核查 LVR 中模型是否真用视觉证据而非语言先验或捷径，时间戳这类索引与对齐结构也可能类比 latent 中位置、对齐信息的作用，值得进一步阅读方法细节。
